weeks.content:
Help without being asked
Kindness jar for the class

Angry feelings are normal
Calm tools, breathe, count, walk

Finish what I start
Little jobs done well

Happy with what I have
Greed steals joy

Do right even when afraid
Stand up for the picked on child

Keep safe secrets
Defend my friends' good name

Share and take turns
Play by the rules

Serve at home and in class
Be the helper

Be a bridge, not a bomb
Solve quarrels with words

Share our service stories
Helper of the term
